structure: Exactly one h2#efficiency-and-price with secnum {{S}}. One figure (#fig-price-ledger) with figure-head, figure-body and figure-caption, labelled 'Figure {{N}}'. The prose ref 'Figure {{fig-price-ledger}}' follows the assemble convention. The figure is HTML stack rows with no SVG, so no markers. No img, link or script. Tags balance and the only ids are efficiency-and-price and fig-price-ledger. No unescaped <, > or & inside <code>. The figure draws what its caption claims: blue cells are code, green and red cells are lab numbers, and the last column plus the pairings are badged reconstruction
